WITH acct AS (
  SELECT a.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region,
         SUM(CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS account_sum,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
)
SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, txn_count,
       CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share_of_region
FROM acct
ORDER BY (CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region)) IS NULL,
         share_of_region DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Transactions of type VYBER (undocumented direction) or any other type are excluded from the signed sum but still counted in the transaction count.
Region total is the sum of the account sums within the region (computed after inner joins). Share is computed in floating point; if a region's total is 0, the share is NULL and sorted last.
